Bramley to Cranfold Walk

Bramley to Cranfold
Length

Main Walk: 13¼ km (8.2 miles). Three hours 20 minutes walking time. For the whole excursion including trains, sights and meals, allow at least 8 hours.

Longer Walk, via Dunmere Park: 16 km (9.9 miles). Four hours walking time.

Short Walk, finishing at Frantham station: 11 km (6.8 miles). Two hours 45 minutes walking time.

OS Map

Explorer 136. Bramley, map reference TQ000000, is in East Sussex, 7 km SE of Cranfold, which is in Kent.

Toughness

4 out of 10 (5 for the Longer Walk, 3 for the Short Walk).

Features

This short walk near the county border takes in open ridges with fine views, interspersed with wooded valleys.

Walk Notes

The Short Walk leaves the main route at the green in Frantham and follows a lane to the station, making a total walk of 11 km.

Transport

Take the train nearest to 9.30 am from London Bridge to Bramley (journey time about 1 hour 5 minutes). Return from Cranfold.

By Train

Out (not a train station)

Back (not a train station)

Lunch

The village of Frantham (after 8¼ km) has two good pubs as well as a convenience store, open daily. The suggested lunch pub is the popular George Inn (01234-567893; closed Mon lunchtime) on a quiet street by the church; it has a beer garden and serves good food, up to 2.30pm. The equally good alternative is the Abergaveny Arms (01234-567894; closed Mon) on the main road.

Tea

On the main ending you pass several cafés on the High Street, such as Juliets at #54 (01234-567895; open Tue–Fri & Sun to 4pm; Sat to 5pm).
